categories.main_business_segments: TD SYNNEX operates in three reportable segments based on geographic regions: the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJ). The company’s offerings are grouped into two primary solutions portfolios: Endpoint Solutions (personal computing devices, peripherals, mobile phones, printers, and endpoint software) and Advanced Solutions (data center technologies, hybrid cloud, security, storage, networking, servers, and hyperscale infrastructure).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: TD SYNNEX leverages advanced distribution automation, proprietary IT systems, and integration facilities to aggregate and deliver IT hardware, software, and systems. The company uses radio frequency and bar code scanning, robotic automation, and digital video imaging in its warehouses, and provides systems design, build-to-order/configure-to-order assembly, and cloud platform services. Its cloud platform enables provisioning, billing, and management of cloud-based solutions, while logistics and supply chain management are supported by sophisticated forecasting and inventory control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 150,000 active reseller customers, including value-added resellers (VARs), corporate and government resellers, system integrators, direct marketers, retailers, and managed service providers (MSPs). End markets include large enterprises, SMBs, government, healthcare, and individual consumers. TD SYNNEX also provides specialized IT solutions for key verticals such as government and healthcare, and supports OEMs in reaching fragmented markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: TD SYNNEX has a global footprint with operations in the Americas, Europe, and APJ, generating approximately 47% of its revenue from international operations in fiscal 2023. The company operates 168 facilities worldwide, with principal markets in the United States, France, and other countries across its three geographic segments.
categories.supply_chain_position: TD SYNNEX operates primarily as a downstream distributor and solutions aggregator within the IT supply chain. It acts as an intermediary between OEM suppliers and a broad base of resellers and end-users, providing value-added services such as integration, logistics, and aftermarket support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include investing in high-growth technologies (hybrid cloud, security, data analytics, AI, hyperscale infrastructure, and services), strengthening its end-to-end portfolio (including technology-as-a-service and recurring revenue models), driving digital transformation through automation and analytics, and expanding its global footprint. TD SYNNEX is focused on enhancing operational excellence and customer experience while broadening its presence in high-growth technology segments.
categories.revenue_model: TD SYNNEX primarily generates revenue through the sale and distribution of IT hardware, software, and systems to resellers and retailers. Additional revenue streams include services such as systems integration, logistics, cloud services, financial services (leasing, DaaS), and marketing services. Some contracts are recognized on a net basis, especially for logistics and cloud services, while the majority of revenue is from product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Arrow Electronics, Ingram Micro, ScanSource, ALSO Holding, Esprinet, Westcon-Comstor, VSTECS Holdings, Synnex Technology International Corp., and Redington Group. TD SYNNEX is positioned as a leading global distributor and solutions aggregator, often competing with both regional and international distributors as well as OEMs that sell directly to customers. The industry is highly competitive and fragmented, with ongoing consolidation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended November 30, 2023, TD SYNNEX reported revenue of $57.6 billion, making it a Fortune 100 company and one of the largest IT distributors globally. Revenue declined 7.7% year-over-year, primarily due to post-pandemic declines in personal computing products, partially offset by growth in advanced solutions. The company maintains low gross and operating margins typical of the distribution industry, with a strong cash flow and significant scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TD SYNNEX differentiates itself by offering a comprehensive, end-to-end portfolio of IT products and services, deep integration and logistics capabilities, and a global reach that connects leading and emerging technology vendors with a vast reseller network. Its value proposition centers on enabling digital transformation, providing access to high-growth technologies, and delivering operational efficiencies and tailored solutions that help customers manage complex IT ecosystems and achieve desired business outcomes.
